scope: synthetic fixed score-Gram information-headroom gate; not measured LLM gradients
gram_definition: deterministic fixed PSD matrices, each trace 1, independent of p and outcomes; known synthetic geometry
controls: isotropic=I/4 matches previous scalar objective; aligned-null annihilates centered credits; equicorrelated-control is exactly .5 times scalar risk
gradient_JADA: observed fixed synthetic G plus Jeffreys posterior mean and posterior E[p(1-p)] from current pilots; coefficients variance_j*[J(mean)^T G J(mean)]_jj; positive integer separable allocator; no current true p or main outcomes
oracle_information: gradient nonlinear oracles know true p and fixed G; adaptive additionally uses observed pilots; scalar oracles optimize I/4 then are scored on G
development: 96 consumed confirmation vectors and six stress regimes from pilot-information gate; never fresh evidence
engine: exact all positive main allocations and all pilot/main count states; vector batches32
primary_estimand: equal weight four primary Grams and three settings within each probability-vector cluster; relative reduction of mean gradient-MSE, not mean of individual relative ratios
primary_gate: HEADROOM_FOR_GRADIENT_CPU only if adaptive-gradient-oracle lower95 reduction vs uniform >5% AND lower95 reduction vs adaptive-scalar-oracle >5%; otherwise NO_OBJECTIVE_SPECIFIC_SIGNAL
intervals: stratified paired vector-cluster Welch-Satterthwaite t delta intervals on fresh confirmation; fixed synthetic Grams and settings are repeated measurements, not independent vectors
null_handling: aligned-null is reported as exact zero-loss boundary; relative ratios undefined and excluded by predeclared primary design
limits: headroom only; G supplied by toy model, not estimated from real pilot score gradients; no reward-score dependence or training inference; no winner-selected Gram, distribution change or primary method switch
